ui.story.name: Raju Bhai
ui.story.b1: Psst! Over here! Quick, before anyone hears.
ui.story.b2: Last night a fake "bank" call cleaned out a family's savings. By morning, three more phones in our mohalla had the same trap!
ui.story.b3: The Cyber Crime Cell needs a sharp new detective. I told them about you.
ui.story.b4: Open each victim's phone. Spot the trick. Stop the next scam before it strikes. Are you in?
